You are rebuilding every page of the **Отзывы о Nyxa** template, a reviews site (angle: payout-focus). Keep the section order, the content and every rule in the brief. Write the page text exactly as given (it is in Russian); write code and comments in English. If something in the brief is missing or unclear, ask instead of guessing, and never invent claims, figures, offers or reviews.

**Target stack:** WordPress with the SX ACF blocks (`sx/<block>` from `wp/sx-blocks.php`). If you use another stack (plain HTML/CSS, React/Next.js, another CMS), build one component per section with the listed fields as props.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Sections appear in the order given, with the same layout variant (or an equivalent layout).
- [ ] All text is used exactly as given; nothing invented (no extra claims, figures, offers or reviews).
- [ ] One H1 per page; headings do not skip levels.
- [ ] No horizontal scrolling at 375px; tap targets at least 44px.
- [ ] Each page is under 64 KB of HTML and CSS (images excluded).
- [ ] The structured data listed for each page is present and valid.
- [ ] Every internal link opens an existing page.
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA, focus is visible, images have alt text.
- [ ] Every rule in the market guidance and the block rules holds on every page.

---

# Rebuild brief: Отзывы о Nyxa

_Follow the system prompt (role, target stack, acceptance checklist) together with this brief._

## Site type guidance

- Purpose: player reviews of one brand, with computed scores and topic filters.
- Negative reviews stay visible; never hide, reorder or soften reviews by rating.
- Scores are computed from the reviews; never type a score by hand.
- Brand replies are shown under the review they answer and are labelled as the brand's.
- Sample (made-up) reviews may only ship in demos and must be labelled as samples there.
- The moderation policy page explains what is removed and why.

## Market guidance

### Market context (from the market settings)

- Market: Kazakhstan (`kz`), languages ru, kk, currency KZT (₸)
- Minimum age: 21+
- Products allowed: sports, casino
- Promotions allowed: welcome_bonus, deposit_bonus, free_bets, promo_code, odds_boost, cashback, loyalty, tournaments
- Payment methods: Kaspi, Visa, Mastercard, Halyk
- App install paths: iOS app-store, Android apk

### Mandated texts (from the market settings)

- Age notice: Участие в азартных играх разрешено с 21 года.
- Licence: Лицензия РК
- Self-exclusion: Вы можете ограничить своё участие в азартных играх через eGov.

### Rules you must not break

- Every page opens with an age gate (21+) before any gambling content.
- Every page has the responsible-gambling panel (usually in the footer) with the market text: age notice, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion and helpline where given. Never type this text yourself; it comes from the market settings.
- Minimum age is 21: the age gate and every age line say 21+.
- Show only these payment methods: Kaspi, Visa, Mastercard, Halyk.
- Amounts are in KZT (₸).

### Market-specific rules

- Online bets are processed through the Unified Accounting Centre (ЕУЦ).
- Identification goes through eGov (or video identification); say so on sign-up pages.
- Self-limitation is available through eGov; mention it on responsible-gambling content.

## Site context

- Site: Отзывы о Nyxa (https://nyxa-otzyvy.example), brand or publisher: Nyxa
- Site type: reviews, angle payout-focus; language `ru`, text direction `ltr`
- Pages (6):
  - `on-compact-index.html` — Отзывы о Nyxa: оценки игроков, выплаты и поддержка
  - `on-compact-reviews.html` — Все отзывы о Nyxa с фильтром по темам
  - `on-compact-reviews-2.html` — Все отзывы о Nyxa с фильтром по темам · страница 2
  - `on-compact-payout-reviews.html` — Отзывы о выплатах Nyxa: Kaspi, Halyk и карты
  - `on-compact-write-a-review.html` — Написать отзыв о Nyxa
  - `on-compact-how-we-moderate.html` — Как мы модерируем отзывы о Nyxa

Fonts (Google Fonts): Manrope.

Layout is mobile-first: it must work from 375px to 1440px wide.

## Block rules

- Affiliate disclosure: Fixed wording per locale; cannot be removed on review sites.
- Header: One-page landing and app pages use 'minimal' (no nav) so attention stays on the conversion.
- Header: The CTA stays visible at every width; on mobile the nav collapses into a menu, the CTA does not.
- Rating summary: No typed-in scores: everything comes from brands/reviews/<brand>.json.
- Rating summary: No AggregateRating structured data.
- Trust bar: Values come from brand facts and market config; nothing is typed by hand.
- Trust bar: Rating shows only when the brand has facts.rating_source.
- Trust bar: Sits directly under the hero (section 2 or 3).
- Topic scores: Computed from the review feed; topics without reviews are hidden.
- Review list: Newest first, every published review; never sorted or filtered by rating by default.
- Review list: The CTA sits between reviews, never inside a review card.
- Editor box: Person comes from the site config "editor" {name, role, bio}; renders nothing (and warns) without it.
- FAQ: 4-6 questions: legality in the country, deposits/withdrawals, payout time, verification, limits or self-exclusion.
- FAQ: Answers are plain text, 1-3 sentences. No CTA links inside answers.
- Final CTA: Always the last section before the footer.
- Final CTA: Headline 40 characters max. No urgency claims (timers, 'last chance').
- Footer: Always renders the compliance panel; it cannot be switched off.
- Footer: Payment methods come from the market config so they are always locally correct.
- Responsible gambling: All copy comes from markets/<id>.json; never type compliance text into a page.
- Responsible gambling: Every page renders a 'panel' (usually inside the footer). 'strip' is an optional top-of-page addition.
- Responsible gambling: Where a market lists several mandated taglines, one is chosen per site by seed.
- Age gate: Age comes from the market (21 in KZ, 18 in AU/BR). Never hard-code it.
- Age gate: Content stays in the HTML for crawlers; the overlay is shown by script, so no-JS users still see the compliance footer.
- Sticky CTA: Phones only (860px and narrower). Never covers the compliance panel: the footer gets bottom padding.
- Sticky CTA: Shows the market age badge next to the CTA.
- Page links: Internal links only; never a substitute for the brand CTA.
- Text block: Only h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, a, table, blockquote survive; all attributes except href are removed.
- Text block: Links: page:<id> for internal pages, https:// for sources. Brand links belong in CTAs, not in prose.
- Page title: The answer line states the page's key fact in one sentence, above the fold on phones.
- Review form: No incentives for reviews. Asks only for a display name; never email, phone or account numbers.
- Steps: Exactly 3 steps; numbers are used because the order is real.
- Steps: Mention verification and deposit limits honestly; do not promise instant approval.

## Page `on-compact-index.html`

- Title tag: Отзывы о Nyxa: оценки игроков, выплаты и поддержка
- Meta description: Что игроки пишут о Nyxa в Казахстане: выплаты на Kaspi, верификация, поддержка и приложение. Публикуем и хорошие, и плохие отзывы. 21+.
- The only H1: Отзывы игроков о Nyxa
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, FAQPage, WebSite
- Links to: `on-compact-how-we-moderate.html`, `on-compact-index.html`, `on-compact-reviews.html`, `on-compact-payout-reviews.html`, `on-compact-write-a-review.html`

### Sections, in order

1. **Affiliate disclosure** — block `sx/disclosure`, variant `chip`, role `top`
   Purpose: One-line affiliate disclosure with a link to the moderation policy. Every page of a review site.
2. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `inline`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `note`: "Лицензия РК"
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: true
3. **Rating summary** — block `sx/rating-summary`, variant `board`, role `hero`
   Purpose: Hero for review sites: average score, review count, 5-to-1 distribution, one topic score and the CTA. Every number is computed from the review feed.
   - `title`: "Отзывы игроков о Nyxa"
   - `subtitle`: "Что пишут о выплатах, проверке документов и поддержке. Мы публикуем все отзывы, кроме спама и оскорблений."
   - `lead_topic`: "payouts"
4. **Trust bar** — block `sx/trust-bar`, variant `strip`, role `trust`
   Purpose: Licence, payout time, years operating, local payments and (only if sourced) rating.
   - `items`: `["licence","payout","since","payments"]`
5. **Topic scores** — block `sx/topic-scores`, variant `bars`, role `content`
   Purpose: Average score and review count per topic (payouts, verification, support...), each linking to those reviews.
6. **Review list** — block `sx/review-list`, variant `compact`, role `content`
   Purpose: Published reviews, newest first. Optional topic and rating filters (pure CSS, no JavaScript needed) and a CTA after every few reviews.
   - `mode`: "latest"
   - `limit`: "6"
   - `filters`: false
   - `cta_every`: "0"
7. **Editor box** — block `sx/editor-box`, variant `card`, role `trust`
   Purpose: Who looks after this page: editor card with role, bio, last update and the moderation policy, plus share links.
   - `share`: true
8. **FAQ** — block `sx/faq`, variant `accordion`, role `content`
   Purpose: Answers the objections that stop sign-ups. Emits FAQPage structured data.
   - `items`: `[{"q":"Это настоящие отзывы?","a":"Да. Каждый отзыв оставил игрок, и модератор прочитал его перед публикацией. Негативные отзывы мы тоже публикуем — удаляем только спам, оскорбления и личные данные."},{"q":"Вы удаляете плохие отзывы?","a":"Нет. Мы удаляем только спам, оскорбления, личные данные и рекламу. Отрицательные отзывы остаются."},{"q":"Откуда берутся ответы Nyxa?","a":"Ответы пишет сама Nyxa. Мы публикуем их под отзывом с пометкой «Ответ Nyxa»."},{"q":"Вы связаны с Nyxa?","a":"Мы получаем комиссию за регистрации по нашим ссылкам. Это не влияет на то, какие отзывы публикуются."}]`
9. **Final CTA** — block `sx/cta-band`, variant `solid`, role `content`
   Purpose: The last push before the footer: short headline, the CTA and two proof points.
   - `title`: "Решили попробовать?"
   - `text`: "Регистрация в Nyxa занимает несколько минут. Только для лиц старше 21 года."
   - `show_code`: false
10. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `compact`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `panel`
     - `show_verify`: false
11. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `fullscreen`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false
12. **Sticky CTA** — block `sx/sticky-cta`, variant `pill`, role `sticky`
   Purpose: Bottom CTA on phones. Appears once the hero CTA scrolls away; hides while the final CTA is on screen.

- Title tag: Написать отзыв о Nyxa
- Meta description: Расскажите о своём опыте с Nyxa. Мы публикуем и положительные, и отрицательные отзывы после модерации.
- The only H1: Написать отзыв о Nyxa

### Sections, in order

1. **Affiliate disclosure** — block `sx/disclosure`, variant `chip`, role `top`
   Purpose: One-line affiliate disclosure with a link to the moderation policy. Every page of a review site.
2. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `inline`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `note`: "Лицензия РК"
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: true
3. **Page title** — block `sx/page-hero`, variant `compact`, role `hero`
   Purpose: Short hero for service pages: breadcrumbs, title, the one-line answer, CTA.

## Page `on-compact-how-we-moderate.html`

- Title tag: Как мы модерируем отзывы о Nyxa
- Meta description: Какие отзывы мы удаляем, какие никогда не удаляем, откуда берутся ответы Nyxa и как мы зарабатываем.
- The only H1: Как мы модерируем отзывы
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, BreadcrumbList
- Links to: `on-compact-how-we-moderate.html`, `on-compact-index.html`, `on-compact-reviews.html`, `on-compact-payout-reviews.html`, `on-compact-write-a-review.html`
